questions.question: Are welded rims safe to use?
questions.explanation: Check your wheels and rims before driving. Wheels or rims that have been welded are not safe and should not be used.

questions.question: Why is backing up with a trailer dangerous?

options.text: The driver cannot see well behind the trailer.
Extra weight may be in the front of the vehicle.
Cargo may fall out of the trailer.
Trailers are not designed to go in reverse.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver cannot see well behind the trailer.
questions.explanation: Backing is always dangerous because you cannot see everything behind your vehicle. Only back up if absolutely necessary.

questions.question: When backing up to couple a trailer, where should the tractor be positioned?

options.text: Directly in front of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Directly in front of the trailer.
questions.explanation: Position the tractor directly in front of the trailer when backing up to couple. Backing at an angle can move the trailer and break the landing gear.

questions.question: What condition must leaf springs be in?
questions.explanation: Check that leaf springs have no missing or broken leaves. If one-fourth or more of the leaves are missing, the vehicle cannot be driven until it is fixed.

questions.question: What do air tank drains do?

options.text: Allow rain water to enter the tanks.
Remove water and oil from the air tanks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Remove water and oil from the air tanks.
questions.explanation: Compressed air contains water and compressor oil. If left in the system, they can damage the brakes. Open the air tank drains every day to remove this buildup.

questions.question: What is the most common type of foundation brake?
questions.explanation: The S-cam drum brake is the most common type of foundation brake.

questions.question: When checking coupling equipment, what should NOT happen to air lines?

options.text: Be connected to the glad hands.

questions.explanation: Check that all coupling parts work properly. Air lines must be firmly attached to the glad hands, have no leaks, and have enough slack for easy turning.

questions.question: When visibility is poor, how should you make your vehicle more visible?
questions.explanation: In poor visibility (dawn, dusk, rain, or snow), turn on your low beam headlights. Do not use high beams when other vehicles are nearby.

questions.question: Which tire condition is NOT a problem?

options.text: Front tire tread depth of at least 4/32 inch

questions.correctAnswerText: Front tire tread depth of at least 4/32 inch
questions.explanation: Check tires for: air pressure that is too high or too low, mixing radial and bias-ply tires, front tire tread less than 4/32 inch, and other tire tread less than 2/32 inch.

questions.question: Is a fire extinguisher required safety equipment?
questions.explanation: Your vehicle must have at least one fire extinguisher as required emergency equipment.

questions.question: If you see lights ahead while driving in fog, what should you know?

options.text: You can assume the lights are on the road.
The lights might be a reflection.
The lights might be an optical illusion.
The lights may not show where the road is. A vehicle may have pulled off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lights may not show where the road is. A vehicle may have pulled off the road.
questions.explanation: In fog, lights are not a reliable way to find the road. The lights could be from a vehicle that has left the road.

questions.question: Most heavy vehicles use the ____ method when changing gears.
questions.explanation: Most heavy vehicles with manual transmissions require double clutching to change gears.

questions.question: What makes up the emergency brake system?

options.text: Only parts of the parking brake system
Only parts of the service brake system
Parts of both the parking and service brake systems

questions.correctAnswerText: Parts of both the parking and service brake systems
questions.explanation: An air brake system has three different braking systems: service brakes, parking brakes, and emergency brakes. The emergency brake system uses parts from both the parking and service brake systems.

questions.question: What can extremely hot temperatures cause?
questions.explanation: Hot air expands, which increases tire pressure. High pressure can cause tire failure. Check your tire pressure regularly when driving in hot weather.

questions.question: What color are ABS malfunction lamps?
questions.explanation: Vehicles with Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS) have yellow malfunction lamps.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: Allow you to drive faster than normal
Allow you to follow other vehicles more closely than normal
Allow you to drive less carefully than normal
It does not decrease your stopping distance

questions.correctAnswerText: It does not decrease your stopping distance
questions.explanation: ABS helps you keep control when braking hard. However, ABS does not necessarily make you stop faster.

questions.question: Why should you check tires regularly in very hot weather?

options.text: Air pressure may increase as the temperature rises

questions.correctAnswerText: Air pressure may increase as the temperature rises
questions.explanation: Hot air expands. This means tire pressure can reach dangerous levels in hot weather. If this happens, stop and let your tires cool. Do not let air out, as the pressure will drop too low when the tires cool.

questions.question: In a set of triples, what should you do with the shut-off valves at the rear of the middle trailer?
questions.explanation: When driving doubles or triples, close the shut-off valves only at the rear of the last trailer. Keep all other shut-off valves open.

questions.question: If your trailer's spring brakes do not release when you press the tractor air supply control, what should you do?

options.text: Turn the engine off and on again

questions.explanation: Check that all equipment works properly before you drive. If the trailer's spring brakes do not release, make sure the air line connections are tight and properly attached.

questions.question: What may rust around wheel nuts indicate?
questions.explanation: Always inspect your tires before driving. Rust around wheel nuts may mean they are loose.
